preconditions.expression: all(1 <= m <= n <= 5000 for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and ' ' in line[0])
preconditions.description: Input must contain exactly one line with two integers n and m where 1 ≤ m ≤ n ≤ 5000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(p) < 5000 for p in stdin.splitlines()[1].split())
preconditions.description: The second line must contain exactly n integers p_i where 0 ≤ p_i < 5000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(c) <= m for c in stdin.splitlines()[2].split())
preconditions.description: The third line must contain exactly n integers c_i where 1 ≤ c_i ≤ m.
The fourth line must contain exactly one integer d where 1 ≤ d ≤ n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(k) <= n for k in stdin.splitlines()[4:4+d])
preconditions.description: Each of the next d lines must contain exactly one integer k_i where 1 ≤ k_i ≤ n, and each k_i must correspond to a student not previously left.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 1 and 0 <= int(line) <= 5000 for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each line of stdout must contain exactly one integer representing the maximum possible team strength for that day, where 0 ≤ strength ≤ 5000.
The number of output lines must exactly match d, the number of days specified in the input.

postconditions.expression: all(mex_of_team(potentials) == int(line) for line, potentials in zip(stdout.splitlines(), compute_daily_potentials(stdin)))
postconditions.description: For each day, the output must be the maximum possible mex of the team formed by selecting one student from each non-empty club after the students who left have been removed. The mex is computed as the smallest non-negative integer not present in the multiset of selected students' potentials.
